attribution: Nutrition facts as published by each chain for this market (see source per item). Chain and product names are trademarks of their owners; Kandro is not affiliated with any chain.

chains.name: Burger King
chains.notes: Values read on 25 Oct 2026 from bk.com's official Nutrition Explorer; the page loads them from Burger King US's own content API (Sanity dataset prod_bk_us, query staticNutritionPage). Used the 'nutritionWithModifiers' block, i.e. the item with its default build, which is what the explorer displays (e.g. Fully Loaded Croissan'wich 620 Cal). servingG is the published weight of that default build where one is given (omitted for drinks and where the API gives 0). French Toast Sticks include the default syrup packet.

chains.name: Chick-fil-A
chains.notes: Values per serving as listed in the nutrition table embedded in chick-fil-a.com/nutrition-allergens (read 25 Oct 2026), serving size in grams as published (drinks also listed in grams). Default builds: sandwiches/salads/wraps as listed including their default dressing where the table includes it. Hash Brown Scramble Bowl default protein not stated in the table, so no meat tag.

chains.name: Chipotle
chains.notes: Build-your-own chain: Chipotle publishes no totals for burritos/bowls, only per-ingredient values, so each ingredient is its own item with component=true (the app may add up a user's chosen build, but no summed item is stored here). Values from the official US Nutrition Facts PDF linked as 'Full Nutrition Facts' from chipotle.com/nutrition-calculator (file US-Nutrition-Facts-Paper-Menu-3-2025.pdf, sheet code OCT-2024-US-CK). servingG converted from the published oz (x28.35) / fl oz (x29.57 ml); fl-oz salsas/dressing and tortillas have no gram weight. Fountain drink line-up varies by location (Coca-Cola vs Pepsi sheet); Coca-Cola sheet used. Standard entree portions are 4 oz protein, 4 oz rice, 4 oz beans. Sofritas tagged vegetarian based on 'organic plant-based protein'.

chains.name: Five Guys
chains.sourceTitle: Five Guys USA – Nutrition & Allergen Information (9-1-2026)
chains.notes: Five Guys US publishes values only per component (no totals for burgers/sandwiches), so burger/hot-dog parts are stored as component=true items; nothing is summed here. IMPORTANT: the Hamburger Patty (65 g, 302 cal, 16 g protein, 17 g fat) and Mini Patty (35 g, 163 cal) rows were DROPPED because the published calories do not match the published macros (Atwater 217 vs 302 kcal, 117 vs 163 kcal) - a reviewer may want to confirm with Five Guys before adding a patty, without which a burger cannot be assembled. Hot dog uses the Supplier H row (Supplier K: 260 cal, 11 g protein, 24 g fat); bacon uses Supplier S, cheese Supplier K, mayonnaise Supplier S. Fries are cooked in refined peanut oil (ingredients: potatoes, refined peanut oil, salt; no allergen marked) - tagged vegan/lactose-free from that listing. No zero-kcal drink is published (fountain sodas and coffee have no values in the guide). Shake = vanilla shake base without mix-ins or whipped cream.

chains.name: In-N-Out Burger
chains.notes: Values from the official In-N-Out nutrition PDF dated January 2026 (in-n-out.com/docs/.../nutrition_info.pdf, found via in-n-out.com; the HTML nutrition page is behind bot protection and was not scraped). Burgers include lettuce, tomato and spread; 'Protein Style' replaces the bun with lettuce. Soft drinks use the 'with ice' Medium column; ml are converted from the published fl oz (x29.57). Shakes are listed as 15 oz with no gram weight. No breakfast menu. Fries are 'potatoes prepared fresh in 100% sunflower oil' (tagged vegan from that description).

chains.name: McDonald's
chains.notes: Values per item as served, read from the official itemDetails JSON (country=US) that the mcdonalds.com/us product pages load; the source field gives the product page. No serving weight is published in the US JSON (serving_size fields empty), so servingG is omitted. Coca-Cola values are the 'No Ice' entries the US site lists. US fries and hash browns contain natural beef flavor, so they are not tagged vegetarian. Snack Wrap and McCrispy Strips are marketed as 'Now Crispier' on the permanent menu.

chains.name: Panda Express
chains.notes: Read on 2026-10-25 from the official HTML nutrition table at pandaexpress.com/nutritioninformation (site blocks curl via DataDome; page was read in a normal browser, no CAPTCHA). Portions are published in ounces only (kept in servingLabel; no gram conversion). Entrees are a single entree portion (category 'bowl'); bases (rice, chow mein, super greens) are 'side'. A Panda Bowl = 1 base + 1 entree, a Plate = 1 base + 2 entrees, so the app can combine items. Items marked '*' (regional/limited time) and '**' regional beverages were excluded; promotional entrees are not listed by Panda.

chains.name: Panera Bread
chains.sourceTitle: Panera Bread Nutrition Guide (US), effective 9/2/2026, Edition 1
chains.notes: Values from the official US 'Panera Bread Nutrition Guide - Effective 9/2/2026 Edition 1' linked as 'United States Nutrition Information Guide PDF' on panerabread.com (the site returns 403 to curl, so the PDF was retrieved via WebFetch and read locally). Salads include their standard dressing as built in the guide's whole/half rows. Gram weights are not published (only portion descriptions); drinks carry the published mL. Soup bowl = 1 1/2 cups. No item tagged lactose-free (allergen guide not parsed). Several salads/sandwiches may contain bacon not shown in the name; pork is tagged only where the name says bacon.

chains.name: Popeyes
chains.notes: Values from the official 'Popeyes USA Nutrition Guide, January 2026' PDF (PLK_Nutrition.pdf) served from the Popeyes US website CMS (Sanity project czqk28jt, dataset prod_plk_us, the same backend popeyes.com loads). Signature chicken, tenders and sandwiches are listed as 'Classic or Spicy' with identical values. Fried chicken pieces/tenders/wings use category 'snack' (no chicken category in the schema). Sweet Tea omitted: guide lists 180 kcal with 16 g carbs/45 g sugar (inconsistent). Drink sizes are 'Small' without fl oz in the guide. Breakfast items are not available at all locations.

chains.name: Raising Cane's
chains.sourceTitle: Raising Cane's – Nutritional & Allergen Information (WEB), August 2026
chains.notes: Values per serving from the official PDF linked on raisingcanes.com/allergens (dated August 2026; PDF hosted on Raising Cane's Prismic CDN). Columns read as Calories, Total Fat, Sat Fat, Trans Fat, Cholesterol, Sodium, Carbs, Fiber, Sugar, Protein (verified against the per-item Atwater sums). Fiber is omitted where the PDF says '< 1 g'. Combo sugar totals match a 0-calorie drink (e.g. Box Combo 16 g = toast + coleslaw + sauce). Drinks exclude ice; fl oz sizes not converted to ml. Combos are listed as published (the 3 Finger and Box combos are the variants with a 0-calorie drink; the menu page shows the full range up to sugared drinks). The menu page states 400 Cal for fries, the newer August 2026 PDF says 420; the PDF was used. No breakfast menu.

chains.name: Shake Shack
chains.sourceTitle: Shake Shack – Nutritional Information (US master nutrition PDF, 3/25 and 4/1/2025)
chains.notes: Values from the official US 'Master Nutrition' PDF hosted on shakeshack.com (file dated 3/25 and 4/1/2025, the newest PDF reachable). The current nutrition page shakeshack.com/document/2451 sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403), so it could not be compared; a reviewer should spot-check a few values against it. Breakfast items are marked 'not available at all Shacks'. Burgers are '100% all-natural Angus beef', hot dog is '100% all-natural Vienna beef' per the PDF. Featured/LTO shakes and lemonades excluded. No serving weights published.

chains.name: Starbucks
chains.notes: Values read from the JSON that starbucks.com/menu product pages load (/apiproxy/v1/ordering/<productNumber>/<form>), i.e. the same numbers shown on each product page linked in 'source'. Beverages are Grande (16 fl oz, ml converted ~473) in the standard recipe (latte/macchiato with 2% milk; Iced Vanilla Protein Latte with protein-boosted milk and 4 vanilla pumps). Pike Place and Cold Brew are listed at 5 kcal; Iced Black Tea is unsweetened. Food serving grams as published. Turkey Bacon sandwich tagged pork-free because the official ingredient list contains uncured turkey bacon and no pork; lactose-free only where the official allergen field explicitly says 'None' (Oatmeal); beverage allergen fields are blank on the site, so no drink is tagged lactose-free.

chains.name: Subway
chains.notes: Values from the official 'U.S. Nutrition Information - October 2026' PDF linked as 'Nutrition Data Tables (USA)' on subway.com/en-us/menunutrition/nutrition (the CDN stalls curl requests, so the file was retrieved via WebFetch and read locally). 6-inch values are the PDF's standard-recipe rows (the PDF states that footlong = two 6-inch servings). Fresh Fit rows include multigrain bread and all fresh vegetables. Salads exclude dressing; Protein Bowls exclude dressing and cheese. Breakfast, hash browns and soup are marked 'at participating locations' in the PDF. The US PDF has no beverage section, so no drinks (and no zero-kcal drink) are included. Fiber listed as '<1' was omitted.

chains.name: Sweetgreen
chains.notes: Per-serving values as prepared from the official HTML nutrition tables on sweetgreen.com/nutrition (page title 'Updated July 2026'). Serving weights in grams as published; drinks in fl oz (converted to ml not done, servingG omitted). Seasonal/collab items (Autumn Harvest Bowl, Molly's items, Maple Glazed Salmon Plate) and Boston-only items excluded. OLIPOP sodas excluded (published kcal far below 4 kcal/g of listed carbs due to prebiotic fiber). No per-item ingredient lists on the page, so diet tags are only set from item names (chicken/steak/salmon).

chains.name: Taco Bell
chains.sourceTitle: Taco Bell USA – product page 'Nutrition Info' panels (tacobell.com)
chains.notes: REVIEW FLAG: Taco Bell publishes no nutrition PDF/table on tacobell.com (tacobell.com/nutrition/info now redirects to yum.com). The official 'Nutrition Info' panel on each tacobell.com product page is an embedded label iframe served by Nutritionix under Taco Bell's brand id 10197; the product page's own data (nutritionIXID) points to that exact label. Values here were read from those embedded labels and rounded the way the displayed FDA-style label rounds them (kcal to 10, fat to 0.5/1 g, others to 1 g); the rounded kcal match tacobell.com's own calorieCount for every item (e.g. Crunchy Taco 170). Drop this file if Nutritionix-hosted labels are not acceptable, even when embedded by the chain. Default recipe (beef where applicable). Medium fountain drinks are 20 fl oz per the label. Unsweetened tea and water have no label on the site and were skipped. No breakfast items found on the national web menu.

chains.name: Wendy's
chains.sourceTitle: Wendy's USA – national menu product nutrition (order.wendys.com)
chains.notes: Values read from the 'Nutritional Value' panel on each product page of Wendy's official US national menu (order.wendys.com/us/en/national/menu/...), default build and default size as the page shows it. No serving weights are published. Salads are 'Entree Only' values without the dressing packet (the page lists the dressing separately: Caesar 240 kcal, Apple Pecan 90 kcal, Taco Salad 150 kcal per packet). Regular Coca-Cola was skipped because the national page showed 0 kcal (clearly not a valid value). Fries and chili: default size the page shows (fries page shows Jr. size).
